senses.gloss: (contr. of מִי or מַן a. הֲוָא, הֲוַת) [whatever it be, be it as it may,] however, at all events.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 106b:2-3">B. Kam. 106ᵇ</cite> <he>השתא מ׳ הא לא אודי מידי</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>השתא מ׳ לא אודי</he>) now, however, you see, he has not confessed.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 84b:13">B. Mets. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>בתורה מ׳ גדול ממך לא וכ׳</he> in knowledge, at all events, (even according to thy own admission) he was thy superior, (though) I do not know (cannot judge).
<cite ref="Shabbat 125a:13">Sabb. 125ᵃ</cite> <he>אודי לי מ׳ וכ׳</he> do at least admit that &c., v. <cite ref="A01197"><he>אֵיזִי</he></cite>.
Nidd. 6ᵇ קתני מ׳ ככרות וכ׳ at all events it says ‘loaves of T’rumah’; a. v. fr. [Not to be confounded with מֵהָא from this, v. הָא.]
